entries.rationale: Adds the canonical screening verb to a verbless toolId. The tool takes the namespace's full filter set (manifests/tokens-params.ts) and returns a filtered, ranked slice of launchpad tokens, which is `discover`, not a bare listing.

Regrouped under the resource it searches. `trench.search` names an operation with no object; it resolves a name or symbol fragment over the SAME token resource that trench__tokens_discover screens (manifests/search.ts:12-18), so the two now sort together and the discover-vs-search distinction is visible in one glance.

Names the scope. `trench.trades` reads as a namespace-wide tape while it requires a single `token` address and pages over that one token's fills (manifests/trades.ts:18-20). Singular `token` marks the required scoping param; `list` is the canonical verb for the paged read.
Adds the canonical verb; bounded listing of the user's pre-uploaded image locker, metadata only.

Existing snake words preserved, canonical verb appended. `my_` is kept deliberately: the wallet is the session's selected wallet and cannot be overridden (manifests/my-launches.ts:14), so the name states the fixed scope.
mechanical; existing snake segment keeps its words and verb-last order.
mechanical; the three-word action is preserved because the form itself is the approval surface and shortening it to `launch_request` would blur the distinction from trench__launch_execute.
